summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of the 9 storefront/checkout/creator fixes on https://crypto-payment-init-1.preview.emergentagent.com (LIVE prod DB, SAFE MODE). 9/9 targeted behaviors PASS functionally (#1 cart controls, #2a mini-cart, #2 email-required, #2c one-off service toggle, #3 refund address, #4 order number + change-amount->cart, #5 store checkout i18n, #6 chat-bubble/publish occlusion, #7 telegram social separation, #8 $10 minimum). No payment was submitted (stopped at awaiting-payment screen); order EEF6276C left pending as expected. Found 3 real UI defects (blocking overlay on mini-cart FAB, broken 'Find The on' name label, untranslated VAT helper) + 1 layout overlap in merchant storefront products toolbar.

ui_bugs.component: MiniCart FAB vs language onboarding bar
ui_bugs.issue: The first-visit 'Choose your language' bar (data-testid=language-onboarding-bar, fixed bottom, full width) sits on top of the bottom-left mini-cart pill and intercepts pointer events — Playwright normal click on minicart-fab times out with 'language-onboarding-bar intercepts pointer events'. Every first-time visitor (i.e. every real shopper) cannot open the mini-cart until they dismiss the language bar. Fix: raise the FAB above the bar / offset the FAB bottom by the bar height while it is visible.

Label renders 'FIND THE ON' instead of 'Find The Dev Store on'. Root cause: CreatorProfile.tsx:423 uses `Find ${creator.name.split(' ')[0]} on` — first word of 'The Dev Store' is 'The'. Same first-name truncation appears in SupportWidget.tsx:386 placeholder 'Say something nice to The (optional)'. Use the full display name (or handle) when the first token is an article/short word.

After switching to Spanish, one string stays English: 'Businesses in the EU can enter a VAT ID for reverse-charge.' (VAT field helper). All other checkout copies translate correctly (Pago / Correo para recibo y novedades / Pagar con cripto).

'Search products...' input visually overlaps/collides with the action row ('View product orders →', 'View my page', 'New product') — the buttons render on top of the search field (see screenshot storefront.png).
Minor UX: entering a custom amount below $10 only silently disables the Buy button and drops the amount from its label ('Buy'), with no visible '$10 minimum' hint.

Note (not a regression): /devhub/shop product cards have no add-to-cart control, so the review step '#1 on /devhub/shop add the product to cart' can only be done from the product detail page. If an in-grid add-to-cart is intended, it is missing.

issues: Product image placeholder is a broken/empty grey box (no image on product 9) — renders as a large empty square next to the details
Telegram appears both in the 'Find … on' socials row and in the 'Share this page' row (share intent) — rows are correctly separated but the duplicate glyph can confuse

action_items: Fix mini-cart FAB being blocked by the language onboarding bar (z-index / bottom offset) — HIGH, breaks cart access for first-time visitors
Fix 'Find The on' label (CreatorProfile.tsx:423) and 'Say something nice to The' placeholder (SupportWidget.tsx:386) — use full display name
Translate the VAT helper string on /[handle]/checkout
Fix products toolbar overlap on /storefront?tab=products (search input vs buttons)
Optionally show a '$10 minimum' inline hint on the support widget custom amount
critical_code_review_comments: Hardcoded English interpolation in defaultValue (`Find ${name.split(' ')[0]} on`) bypasses i18n and breaks for multi-word store names.

Floating UI layers (minicart FAB bottom-left, support chat FAB bottom-right, language onboarding bar full-width bottom) need one shared z-index/offset system; the chat FAB occlusion logic (data-dyno-anchor='cta') works, but the language bar has no such handling.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 9 requested behaviors functionally pass; 4 additional UI defects found
